text:
I have conducted an independent review of the expenses claims tool and written the release verdict to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/REVIEW.md). The product source code and configuration were left completely unmodified.

### Verdict: **BLOCK** (Do NOT deploy on Monday)

---

### What Was Verified

1. **Automated Acceptance Gate (`accept-check.js`)**: Executed the product acceptance gate in an independent context (`--acceptor-context separate`). The gate returned `BLOCK` due to missing `Trust` documentation in [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md#L1-L17) (`D-systems-architecture`), a missing `/health` endpoint, and missing operations documentation (`D-operability-report`).
2. **Test Execution (`npm test`)**: Executed the project test command. The suite passed 1 unit test in [test/claims.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/test/claims.test.js#L1-L10), but lacks HTTP endpoint tests or error path verification.
3. **UX & Walkthrough Verification**: Attempted step-by-step verification of [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md#L1-L19). [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/public/index.html#L1-L2) is an empty HTML shell (`<main id="app"></main>`) with no scripts, styles, or UI forms.
4. **Codebase & Security Audit**:
   - **Missing UI**: No frontend interface exists for staff or managers.
   - **Authentication Bypass**: `/api/sign-in` accepts arbitrary `isManager` flags from request bodies without verification in [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/src/server.js#L19-L23).
   - **Self-Approval Flaw**: Managers can approve their own submitted claims in [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/src/server.js#L33-L37).
   - **Unvalidated Inputs**: `amountMinor` is completely unvalidated in [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/src/server.js#L25-L29).
   - **Data Integrity**: Data persistence in [src/claims.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-cbcSp2/workspace/src/claims.js#L10-L27) uses non-atomic file writes and sequential ID counters, creating risk of data corruption under concurrent use.
